ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the Minnesota Medicaid fraud case to identify potential wrongdoing and to determine the extent of the fraud
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in the Minnesota Medicaid fraud case could lead to important discoveries about the extent of the fraud and who is responsible. This investigation could also identify potential solutions to prevent similar issues in the future.
